notes.title: v1.1.3 Patch Note
notes.content:
Techinical issues were fixed!

Fixed Issues


 Issue that the pause menu doesn't work correctly in tutorial stage.

notes.title: v1.1.2 Patch Note
notes.content:
There is fixed issue with Assist Mode!

Fixed Issues


 Issue that damage to enemies and Rage gauge recharge doesn't work after updating Assist Mode.

notes.title: v1.1.1 Patch Note
notes.content:
Fixed Issues


 Issues that achievements 'Why...?' and 'Overrun!' doesn't work.

notes.title: v1.1.0 어시스트 모드 업데이트
notes.content:
Assist mode is added to adjust the difficulty of game. You can now adjust the difficulty for better experience.

Added Options

 You can increase the damage to enemy by 200%.
 You can increase the Rage Gauge charge by 200%.

notes.title: v1.0.3 Patch Note
notes.content:
This patch includes fixes for technical issues.

Fixed Issues


 Control issue that gamepad controls not working correctly in the options window.
 Issue in [spoiler]Valefor Ave. #6[/spoiler] stage, that some attacks' hit detection work incorrectly.

notes.title: v1.0.2 Patch Note
notes.content:
Equipments' balance are fixed.

Balance


 Heavy bullet's damage growth incresed. : +20% -> +40%
 Heavy bullet's damage reduction decreased. : -50% -> -30%
 Ricochet's damage growth increased. : +20% -> +40%
 Anger Manager's recharge speed increased. : 5/s -> 8/s
 Scythe of Reverberation's attack position is adjusted to be closer to the player.
 Scythe of Reverberation's attack range increased by 100%.

notes.title: v1.0.1 Hotfix
notes.content:
Fixed few technical issues.

Fixed Issues

 Fixed an issue that SFX volume setting was not applied correctly.
 Fixed an issue that game didn't processed normally when you equip Thunder God's Hammer.

notes.title: v1.0 Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
v1.0 Release on Jan 19th

[Twinkle Hunter] is officially launching on January 19th after nearly a month of Early Access.
Thanks for everyone who have been insterested in the game during long time.

New contents is added on v1.0.

New contents


 Many new members of Twinkle Thieves
 New Weaons, Talismans, and Rage Skills
 20 achievements


Technical fixes, difficulty and balance adjustments will continue beyond v1.0.

notes.title: v1.3.1b Hotfix
notes.content:
Technical issues fixed

Fixed an issue that equipment would not properly equip on the 'Salti' stage.

notes.title: [New Boss!] v1.3.0b Patch Notes
notes.content:
Little spider [Salti] appears from the darkness.



New Content
New member [Salti]is updated.

notes.title: [New Boss!] v1.2.0b Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hunter raids the adobe of  Volcano Core’s Master , [Delta Einfres].



New Content
New member [Delta Einfres]is updated.



Other fixes 
You can now adjust camera shake effect.
When controlling with a game controller, aim assist is enabled.

notes.title: [New Boss!] v1.1.0b Patch Notes
notes.content:
The first boss update! The new member of Twinkle Thieves, [Clockwork Zoo] threatens Hunter!



New Contents
New member 'Clockwork Zoo'is updated.



Boss Fights
All bosses' difficulty increas
Fury Gage required to use Fury Skills increased. : 600 -> 700



Equipments
The damage of Mistletoe Bow increased. (26 → 28 per a attack)
Added a new power on Ares' Flag for accelerating attacks by 100%.
The damage of Scythe of Reverberation and Scythe of Reverberation(Overrunned) increased. : 8 -> 10 per a attack
The Duration of Scythe of Reverberation(Overrunned) increased. : 7s -> 8s



Other fixes 
Post processing was applied to improve the visual.
